notes.en: When using Himeko as a Super Break DPS, her traces can be ignored.

summary.en:
- Himeko is a DPS unit who primarily deals damage through her follow-up attacks.
- When normal enemies or Elite enemies become Weakness Broken, Himeko gains one or three charges respectively, up to a max of 3 Charges.. Upon reaching three Charges, she unleashes a Follow-Up ATK that deals damage to all enemies.
- Himeko's performance is reliant on Dahlia and Fugue for charge generation and consistent Super Break damage.
- Himeko excels in content where enemies can be frequently Weakness Broken, such as Pure Fiction.
- Despite Himeko having CRIT traces, her damage nowadays is underwhelming, unlike her Toughness damage, making her a viable Break carry.
